The agents didn't resolve this discrepancy clearly, leading to a possible oversight in citing the exact location.

So, the main issue was the incomplete extraction of the place of death from authoritative sources, causing the final answer to be a bit vague. The agents should have cross-checked the information more thoroughly to ensure consistency across all sources.
